source_locator.edition_or_translation: J. M. Ashmand translation from Proclus's Greek paraphrase; 1900 W. Foulsham & Co. new edition
source_locator.short_quote: if ... below the earth, and configurated with the ascendant ... its influence then becomes more languid

condition.configuration: with the Ascendant from the lower heaven or another part below the earth

normalized_rule: When a planet is below the earth and configured with the Ascendant from the lower heaven or another part below the earth, classify its influence as more languid.
synthesis_notes: This is a source-specific traditional influence classification, not a modern physics or psychological claim.
review_notes: Keep this below-horizon branch separate from the no-configuration branch and from the mid-heaven/horizon strength rules.
transmission_notes: The condition is stated in the Ashmand/Proclus main text; no later house-rulership or accidental-dignity system is imported.
